title: Chapter 204 Dr. Jia
content:
Chapter 204 Dr. Jia

The research institute is located in the southeast of the back garden.

After walking for a while, an attic appeared in front of him.

But Wang Shuo was immediately dumbfounded.

There was only a piece of broken tiles and ruins in front of him.

This is the only destroyed building in the Dragon King's underground palace.

"You did it?" Wang Shuo frowned at the yellow-haired Locke.

Locke immediately shook his head.

Wang Shuo checked the map again, showing that there was a small red dot in this place.

Could there be another underground palace?

Wang Shuo asked his soldiers to clean up the rubble and rotten wood on the surface, and finally revealed an underground passage.

Sure enough, it was as Wang Shuo expected.

Entering the passage, it was pitch black. After everyone lit torches, they could see the situation inside clearly.

There was a lot of silt and sewage in the passage, but it was not deep, only less than 10 centimeters.

Gong Zheng was still walking in the front.

After a few steps, dozens of crossbows were shot from the stone walls on both sides.

Gong Zheng was tough and thick-skinned, so although he was hit by an arrow, it was not a big deal.

"Everyone be careful, there are traps inside."

Wang Shuo carefully checked the map again and found that the various traps were clearly marked on the map.

This was only displayed on the map after entering the passage.

Wang Shuo let out a long breath and secretly thought that he was lucky.

With the markings, there is no need to be afraid of the various hidden traps.

After experiencing traps such as arrows, rolling stones, fire attacks, dungeons, etc., Wang Shuo and his group finally came to a hall.

It was filled with various shelves and workbenches.

On the shelves, there were various bottles and jars, which contained some transparent liquids and some animal and plant specimens.

On the workbench, there was also a skeleton frame made of animal and human bones.

The shape was strange and weird, and it was scary to look at.

Next to the workbench, there was also a skeleton boss.

His shape was also very strange, and his two arms were actually mechanical arms, not ordinary bones.

He was wearing a soft leather coat with silver glitter and a pair of glasses on his head.

It can be seen that the person in front of him should be a researcher.

"Are you here to deliver the test product?" The skeleton boss laughed strangely.

[Dr. Jia, Silver Boss]

[Level: Level 40]

[Attack: 700]

[Defense: 500]

[Health: 5500]

[Note: The director of the Black Dragon City Research Institute, a weird researcher with a strange personality, he has extensive experience in mechanical life transformation, biomedical research and other fields, and is a genius researcher. ]

Wang Shuo did not dare to underestimate this Dr. Jia, his attack and defense are ridiculously high.

It must be not simple at all.

Dr. Jia did not look back, but looked at the skeleton he had spliced together on the workbench with great concentration, as if he was lost in thought.

What a workaholic!

Wang Shuo wanted to give him a model worker medal.

After waiting for a long time, Dr. Jia was a little impatient and looked back at Wang Shuo and others.

"So you are illegal intruders!" His tone changed grimly, "You dare to break into my workplace, you are simply courting death."

He waved his arm, and a rope shot out from the mechanical arm at an incredibly fast speed.

It directly tied up Ye Xueer and pulled her over.

This incident happened in the blink of an eye, and no one had reacted yet.

He is really a ruthless man who doesn't talk much.

Until Ye Xueer was pulled a few meters away, Wang Shuo reacted, rushed up and grabbed Ye Xueer's hand.

Others also reacted, and Yinghua Guzi used the samurai sword in her hand to cut the rope.
